interpretation: U7.3H remains a valid frozen failure for fresh-process full-file revalidation. U4.5C tests a different product mechanism: four complete session admissions per process hash the full source, profile and all preview files, then retain independently re-hashed immutable preview bytes. Sixty-four warm lookups across forward/reverse processes return the exact three canonical previews without filesystem access, decode, render or write; the worst lookup is 0.3104 ms against the 300 ms target. Replacing a disk preview after admission cannot alter the current snapshot and makes a new admission fail closed.
claim_ceiling: Private Windows/Python session-resident warm lookup for three already-rendered non-calibrated Look Approximation previews only. No render acceleration, calibrated stock response, stock distinguishability, installer/release, cross-platform support or multi-stock scientific completion.
